adjudication.rationale: The diff shows EventManager now performs inline DB access and manual credential construction. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, if a destination calendar has `credentialId` but it isn't present in `this.calendarCredentials`, it calls `prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` and then builds a `credential` object by hand (mapping `app.slug` to `appName`, copying fields like `type`, `key`, `userId`, etc.). Similar inline fetching/hand-building was also added in `updateCalendarEvent`. This is a concrete architectural coupling of the core event orchestration logic to Prisma/DB schema rather than relying on injected/preloaded credentials, but it’s not an inherently verifiable runtime defect from the diff alone.
